profile.name: Sabarigirish Radhakrishnan
profile.headline: System & Product Validation Architect | Storage, PCIe/NVMe, Post-Silicon Validation, Platform Architecture | Bengaluru, India
profile.about:
15+ years of experience in post-silicon validation, system-level product validation, platform bring-up, firmware integration, high-speed I/O validation and complex hardware/software debugging across x86-based compute and server architectures.
Strong expertise in PCIe, NVMe, USB, CPU, memory, firmware, BIOS, Linux kernel, device drivers and storage subsystem integration. I translate architecture specifications, product requirements and customer use cases into validation strategies, workload-driven test plans, coverage models, risk-based execution strategies and production-readiness criteria.
Hands-on with PCIe and NVMe system integration, device enumeration and initialization, high-speed I/O debugging, storage performance investigation and cross-layer failure analysis spanning silicon, hardware, firmware, BIOS, drivers and operating systems.
Strong Python automation background: scalable validation frameworks, regression infrastructure, execution dashboards, failure analytics and observability, delivering approximately 35% improvement in validation efficiency.
Experienced in technical leadership, mentoring validation engineers and driving complex investigations to closure, with hands-on exposure to AI/LLM-based engineering productivity solutions including RAG systems.
